notes: Primary muscle group remains picker/browsing taxonomy and does not determine the contribution mapping.
DURATION and OTHER exercises are excluded in v1 because no set-stimulus calibration is locked for those measurement types.
FULL_BODY catalogue exercises are excluded in v1 because the Epley/bodyweight set-quality model is not calibrated for mixed ballistic whole-body patterns.
Review flags identify technique-sensitive, taxonomy-limited, or intentionally deferred cases; they do not make an eligible row invalid.
Phase 19.4 should persist these reviewed decisions as versioned reference data rather than re-deriving mappings from names or primary muscle groups at runtime.
